newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks hit new high after Wall Street rise.
newsitem.headline: French stocks hit new high after Wall Street rise.

text.p: French shares set another high on Friday as U.S. stocks posted strong gains in the wake of market friendly U.S. growth data for the fourth quarter.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index climbed at high as 2,521.88 passing a previous record set at Thursday's close.
The CAC-40 index was up 12.99 points, or 0.52 percent at 2,516.05 points at 1500 GMT.
U.S. stocks rose after U.S. GDP data indicated lower than expected inflation pressure.
